svg.title: Blue White
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection. Actual museum lobby photograph credited E. Scott McDonald and independent project architect Scott Lauer show the full work: blue upper panel joined to a white lower panel. The current exhibition hero depicts Youngerman May, not this work; it is excluded as a reference. This drawing retains the observed oblique projection, not an invented frontal parallelogram or dimensions. Museum describes the commission as a painting; its older wall-sculpture wording remains a classification note.
